Overview, 4 Editions & Zero-Dependency C++20 Architecture

RaggieSoft Help Studio (v0.5.0) is a 100% native static /MT Win32 C++20 help authoring workbench, legacy .CHM and WinHelp .HLP/.CNT decompiler, and sub-5ms F1 context-routing runtime for Windows 11 x64 and ARM64.

Four Binaries in the Box

  • HelpStudio.exe: 8-view tree-first visual IDE with split Markdown/HTML5 editing and pixel-accurate in-process Msftedit.dll F1 preview.
  • rshbuild.exe: Headless CI/CD compiler, WCAG 2.2 AA validator, legacy .CHM/.HLP importer, and AI specification emitter.
  • RaggieSoftHelp.exe: Universal < 650 KB offline F1 viewer supporting .rshm.json modules, LZMS single-EXE packs, and direct .CHM & .HLP/.CNT rescue viewing.
  • rshtests.exe: Automated C++20 verification suite.

Four Named Editions (Community == 100% Architect Parity)

EditionScope & Capabilities
Community EditionFree for hobbyists, solo creators, students, educators, non-profits, and open source — 100% technical parity with Architect Edition and zero watermarks.
Essentials EditionCommercial Tier 1 workstation: visual .rshp Markdown/HTML5 authoring, .rshm.json module pack, standalone <Product>Help.exe, and static HTML5 web portal.
Developer EditionCommercial Tier 2: adds turnkey .CHM/.HHP & .HLP/.CNT/.HPJ importers, C++/C#/VB6/TS F1 SDK emitters, RaggieScript (help.*), and CI/CD rights.
Architect EditionCommercial Tier 3: adds cross-suite federated search, conditional OemTags builds, and automated HTML5 VPAT 2.5 conformance reports.
